portrait.about: Grace Hopper's portrait (public domain, examples/*/grace_hopper.jpg), centred on a grey 640x360 frame

steps.name: mediapipe masks the person
steps.check: (() => { const src = document.getElementById('out'); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 64; c.height = 36; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(src, 0, 0, 64, 36); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, 64, 36).data; const mean = (x0, x1) => { let s = 0, n = 0; for (let y = 4; y < 36; y++) for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) { s += d[(y * 64 + x) * 4]; n++; } return s / n; }; const person = mean(26, 38), sides = (mean(0, 12) + mean(52, 64)) / 2; return { fail: person - sides < 100 && 'the mask does not single out the person', info: `mask ${person.toFixed(0)} on the person, ${sides.toFixed(0)} on the sides, ${document.getElementById('stats').textContent}` }; })()
